summary: Completed testing of UI/UX fixes for IELTS Center platform iteration 8. Verified no error toasts on public page, compact header layout, dynamic social icons, language switching, admin login, and inline group form checkbox alignment. All major requirements from the review request have been successfully implemented.
passed_tests: Public home page loads WITHOUT error toast notifications (no 'Не удалось загрузить филиалы' toast)
Header is compact single row with all elements: brand, nav, social icons, phone, language switcher, login button
Header uses new .header-row CSS class instead of old .nav-grid layout
Social icons in header show dynamically: Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp visible
Footer also shows dynamic social icons: Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp visible
Admin login works with credentials admin/admin123
Group creation form uses .group-create-form CSS class for inline layout
Checkbox 'Инд. группа' is properly aligned inline with prefix, number, year inputs and Create button
Admin dashboard navigation works between tabs
All core admin functionality accessible and working
